correctness.rationale: Every finite diameter-four tree has a unique center and disjoint depth-two branches. A three-round Duplicator strategy truncates counts of leaf children per branch and counts of branches of each leaf-count type at three; it preserves equality and adjacency, leaves diameter four, and never adds vertices. There are exactly 240 canonical multiplicity tuples. Two independently implemented complete Hintikka-type recursions agree on every canonical tree and yield exactly nine distinct rank-three sentence types with minimum graph orders 5,6,6,7,7,7,8,9,10. Literal three-round EF minimax gives the same inequivalence for all 81 ordered pairs of representatives. Therefore the nine-type count and sharp 10-vertex kernel hold for all finite diameter-four trees. The program is replayable; symbolic truncation is essential for universal quantification.

originality.rationale: Comparisons address logical implication, not terminology alone. The 2007 Bohman et al. study gives general definability-depth asymptotics for individual trees; Heuter 1991 studies first-order definability of ordered ranked labelled trees and aperiodicity; Libkin gives general EF/Hintikka tools. None of these yields or states the exact pure-adjacency diameter-four nine-class rank-three quotient with sharp ten-vertex representative. Earlier exact rank-three spectra of star forests and linear forests do not imply the result for branching diameter-four trees. Actual indexed scientific searches found no direct or dominating classification; residual risk of unindexed literature remains.
residual_risks: Unindexed or inaccessible older literature could contain an equivalent exact rank-three diameter-four tree classification.
Only named portions of accessible primary documents were scrutinized, not every argument of every related monograph.
Self-review analysis and replay do not substitute for independent scholarly checking.

value.rationale: The class of finite diameter-four trees is a natural and infinite radius-two structural stratum, containing arbitrarily complex leaf multiplicities and allowing arbitrarily large orders. A complete exact rank-three FO-equivalence classification produces nine and only nine semantic test cases, with the optimally smallest maximal representative size ten. Thus any rank-three sentence has model or countermodel in this family if and only if one occurs among nine concretely specified trees; this is a reusable logical kernel with an intrinsically motivated sharp finite bound, not a bounded census or arbitrary subcase.
